target.name: Legg Mason Capital Management All Cap Fund

listed_quote.quote: If your account application permits, you may be eligible to redeem shares by telephone.

announcement.quote: You are being asked to vote on a proposed reorganization transaction related to your fund, Legg Mason Capital Management All Cap Fund, a series of Legg Mason Partners Equity Trust, a Maryland statutory trust (the “Trust”).

outcome_evidence.quote: If your account application permits, you may be eligible to redeem shares by telephone.

deals.notes: Share classes (Class A, C, I) and shareholder redemption indicate open-end mutual funds; the text never uses the words open-end. The vote was adjourned from July 11 to August 7, 2013 (DEFA14A 0001193125-13-288966); the excerpts do not say how it ended. The episode CIK is the trust that contains the fund, so role is recorded as other.
